project.name: Nashik Civil Hospital — 300-bed Super Speciality Block
project.client: Public Works Department, Government of Maharashtra

boq_items.description: Excavation for foundation in all types of soil and soft murum, depth 0–6 m, incl. dewatering, shoring and strutting, lead up to 50 m and lift up to 1.5 m (basement B1/B2 and sump)
Excavation in hard murum / soft rock by mechanical means incl. controlled breaking (no blasting near live OPD)
Filling in plinth and around basement retaining walls with selected murum in 150 mm layers, watered and compacted to 95% MDD
Providing and laying M15 PCC below raft, footings and sump base, 100 mm thick, incl. curing
Providing and laying design mix M35 RMC in raft foundation incl. pumping, retarder and thermal control (pour size ≤ 350 cum)
Design mix M35 RMC for basement retaining walls RW-N1 to RW-S4 and lift pit walls incl. water bar at kicker
Design mix M30 RMC for RCC columns, shear walls and lift core walls, all levels B2 to terrace, incl. pumping and PCE admixture
Design mix M25 RMC for slabs, beams, landings and staircases at all levels incl. pumping (OT slab 200 mm, typical 175 mm)
Design mix M30 RMC for 1.2 ML fire & domestic sump walls and base with crystalline admixture
Supplying, cutting, bending and placing TMT Fe500D reinforcement up to plinth (raft, retaining walls, sump) incl. binding wire
Supplying, cutting, bending and placing TMT Fe500D reinforcement above plinth (columns, beams, slabs, walls) incl. couplers where shown
Centering and shuttering for raft edges, footings and sump walls (steel plates / ply), incl. removal
Centering and shuttering for suspended slabs incl. cup-lock staging up to 4.2 m, props at ≤ 900 c/c under OT slab
Centering and shuttering for beams, lintels and cantilevers (ply 12 mm, runners at 600 c/c)
Centering and shuttering for columns and shear walls (steel column boxes / ply with tie rods)
Providing and fixing 25 mm / 40 mm / 50 mm cement-concrete cover blocks of M30-equivalent strength (PVC blocks not permitted)
Providing crystalline integral waterproofing to raft, retaining walls and sump (dose 0.8% by weight of cement)
APP modified bitumen membrane 4 mm to basement retaining wall external face with 50 mm PCC protection (hold point before backfill)
AAC block masonry 200 mm in CM 1:4 / thin-bed adhesive for internal walls L1–L7 (density 551–650)
Gypsum plaster 12 mm to internal walls and ceilings of ward and ICU areas incl. corner beads
Seamless conductive/antistatic vinyl flooring 2 mm for modular OT and ICU incl. copper grounding grid
Structural steel for OT pendant support frames and helipad edge frames incl. welding and primer (Fe 410)
Medical gas pipeline sleeves (MS / uPVC) cast in slabs and beams as per SSB-MEP-L3-431

rfis.subject: RW-N1 retaining wall thickness and water bar at kicker
rfis.question: Water table observed at 3.1 m during B2 excavation. SSB-STR-B2-102 R0 shows 300 mm wall with no water bar. Confirm section and kicker detail.
rfis.response: Increase RW-N1 to 350 mm with PVC water bar at kicker; membrane waterproofing inspection is a hold point before backfill. SSB-STR-B2-102 R1 issued.

rfis.subject: Raft construction joint location and waterproofing lap
rfis.question: Raft pour 3 (Zone C) exceeds 350 cum in one go. Propose construction joint along grid 9 with shear keys; confirm membrane lap.
rfis.response: Accepted. Joint along grid 9 with 75 mm shear key and hydrophilic strip; 150 mm membrane lap. No drawing change (SI-014).

rfis.subject: OT bay column main bars for modular OT and pendant loads
rfis.question: Modular OT vendor data shows ceiling pendant and laminar-flow loads higher than design basis. Confirm main bars for C-7, C-8, D-7, D-8.
rfis.response: Upgrade main bars to 12 nos 25 dia with 10 dia ties for C-7, C-8, D-7, D-8. SSB-STR-L3-201 R1 issued 15-Jul-2026.

rfis.subject: Beam B3-G07/B3-G08 depth clash with OT AHU duct
rfis.question: 1200x400 AHU supply duct to OT-3 passes under B3-G08 at 600 deep; false-ceiling height falls below 3.0 m. Advise.
rfis.response: Deepen B3-G07/B3-G08 to 750 with 5 bottom bars, stirrups @ 125 c/c, duct opening per detail 7. SSB-STR-L3-221 R1 issued.

rfis.subject: OT-3 / OT-4 door clear width for bed movement
rfis.question: SSB-ARC-L3-151 R0 shows 1200 clear doors to OT-3 and OT-4; ICU beds with monitors need 1500. Confirm.
rfis.response: Widen OT-3 and OT-4 doors to 1500 clear and relocate scrub bay. SSB-ARC-L3-151 R1 issued.

rfis.subject: Tie spacing at C-7 and C-8 under OT pendant supports
rfis.question: SSB-STR-L3-201 R1 shows 10 dia ties @ 150 c/c at C-7 and C-8. Pendant support brackets sit at mid-height; confirm confinement spacing.
rfis.response: Adopt 10 dia ties @ 100 c/c over full height for C-7 and C-8 (ductile detailing). SSB-STR-L3-201 R2 issued 21-Aug-2026.

rfis.subject: Cover block type for OT slab and columns
rfis.question: Contractor proposes 25 mm PVC cover blocks for the OT slab bottom mesh and 40 mm PVC for columns. Acceptable?
rfis.response: No. Use cement-concrete cover blocks of M30-equivalent strength: 25 mm slab, 40 mm column, 30 mm beam. No drawing change (SI-021).

rfis.subject: Level 3 OT slab thickness 150 vs 200
rfis.question: Modular OT floor loads and vibration criteria from the OT vendor exceed what a 150 mm slab (SSB-STR-L3-211 R0) was designed for. Confirm thickness.
rfis.response: OT floor slab revised to 200 mm, M25. SSB-STR-L3-211 R1 issued 26-Aug-2026; staging to be certified before pour.

rfis.subject: Medical gas sleeve SL-OT-03 clashes with beam B3-G08
rfis.question: Sleeve SL-OT-03 (150 dia) on SSB-MEP-L3-431 R0 falls 90 mm from the face of beam B3-G08. Can it shift 250 mm towards OT-3?
rfis.impact: Pending — L3 OT slab pour dependency

rfis.subject: Electrical conduit density in ICU slab near nurse station
rfis.question: SSB-ELE-L4-461 (For Approval) shows 9 conduits of 25 dia crossing within 400 mm at the ICU nurse station. Confirm reroute before L4 reinforcement.

rfis.subject: Sump excavation shoring after groundwater at 3.2 m
rfis.question: Sump excavation hit groundwater at 3.2 m after rain on 8-Sep; murum sides slumping. Provide shoring design and dewatering scheme before restart.

rfis.subject: Staircase ST-2 waist slab thickness at L3–L4 mid-landing
rfis.question: ST-2 waist slab is not dimensioned on SSB-STR-L3-211 R1. Confirm 175 mm?

code_clauses: IS 456 Cl. 26.4 — Nominal cover depends on exposure (Table 16); Nashik block is moderate exposure. Project NSK nominal covers: raft / footing 50 mm, column and shear wall 40 mm, beam 30 mm, slab 25 mm; sump 45 mm (IS 3370). Site acceptance used on NSK: ±5 mm on the drawing value.

IS 13920 Cl. 7.4 — Special confining reinforcement in columns of ductile frames; spacing not more than 1/4 of the least column dimension and not more than 100 mm in the confinement zone. On NSK, C-7 and C-8 under the OT pendants use 10 dia ties @ 100 c/c over full height (SSB-STR-L3-201 R2, RFI-SSB-006).
IS 456 Cl. 24.1 — Slab thickness governed by span/depth and serviceability. NSK L3 OT floor slab is 200 mm (SSB-STR-L3-211 R1, RFI-SSB-008); typical floors 175 mm.
IS 456 Cl. 11.3.1 — Stripping time: vertical faces 16–24 h, slab soffit props 7 days, beam soffit props 14 days (OPC). NSK strips slab soffits at 7 days and beam soffits at 14 days.
IS 1893 (Part 1) — Nashik lies in seismic zone III (Z = 0.16). The super speciality block is an importance factor 1.5 hospital building with ductile detailing to IS 13920.
IS 3370 (Parts 1 & 2) — Water-retaining structures: minimum M30, crack width control, cover 45 mm on NSK sump (SSB-PLB-GF-401), crystalline admixture and hydro-test before backfill.

IS 14489 — Hot work needs a valid permit, combustibles removed within 11 m, a dedicated trained fire watcher during work and for 60 minutes after, and extinguishers at the work point. No fire watch → stop hot work (applies to HWP-2031, lift core Zone C L4).

BOCW Central Rules 1998 — excavations deeper than 1.5 m need shoring, sloping or benching designed by a competent person, and re-inspection after heavy rain. NSK sump excavation EXC-2017 is suspended until shoring and dewatering are in place (RFI-SSB-011).
